method: Static declaration and service-call tracing, supplemented by named local tests. Declaration counts are not dynamic authorization coverage.

flows.finding: Request identity and organization derive from server context. A castAccess null sequence means organization scope; non-null sequence is loaded. System-admin sequence rebinding is an explicit existing capability, not a bypass to remove.
flows.evidence: static; G01 finite identity evidence remains separate

flows.finding: Organization character/bible/look and sequence-link operations remain with their scoped owners. No ownership or claim moved to the image projection.
Photos, current bible and sheet belong to the organization entity; sequence attach/remove/recast operates through links.
requireUploadRights precedes every storage attachability check, then createForOrganization/addPhotos; optional sheet dispatch is downstream. Null sequence is retained.
requireCheckable and requireUploadRights precede configuration, credential, balance, vision and debit collaborators.
flows.evidence: upload-ownership-contract.test.ts with real D1 ledger and collaborator stubs

flows.finding: Stored-path organization and ledger gates precede bible/reference writes or generation. Non-default generated looks require a default face; uploaded sheets retain their distinct allowed behavior.
Path ownership, storage existence, kind agreement and likeness ledger gates precede create/update and optional vision workflow; audio preserves its existing no-likeness-check behavior.
flows.evidence: attach-element-upload.test.ts and sequence-elements.test.ts; original mocked storage/ledger coverage, not the new real-ledger composition

flows.finding: An authenticated handler accepts mediaUrlSchema and reaches credential/balance/vision/debit collaborators without checking URL owner or rights. The normal UI waits for its upload rights gate; that does not constrain a direct server-function call.
flows.evidence: draft-element-guard-reproduction.mjs and .json; extracted real source, supplied trusted context and all external collaborators stubbed

flows.finding: Upload-target resolution and generation restriction occur before bytes; the classifier workflow starts after storage. read/retry validate checkability and reuse ledger/run state; likeness classification itself is an existing billed operation.
flows.evidence: upload-check.test.ts, upload-rights.test.ts and analyze-talent-media.test.ts; route orchestration statically traced

flows.finding: Ingested references are classified and human attestations recorded before library rows. Inline organization locations use triggerSheet:false; billed sheets enqueue only after sequence creation. Existing API/MCP remain supported.

OAuth scope/trusted tool context and productionAccess parent chain precede shared sheet/recast/upload/element services; tools retain server-derived organization. Admin API-key foreign-sequence access remains explicitly limited by tool-context.
flows.evidence: mcp/cast-audio-generation.test.ts; generation upload adapters statically traced, not all dynamically exercised

flows.finding: Portrait starts after a saved sheet version, deduplicated by versionId. G03 parent runtime configuration propagation is retained; request uploads capture independently. Its optional failure behavior is unchanged.
flows.evidence: sheet-portrait-context.test.ts, sheet-portrait-step.test.ts and sheet-portrait.test.ts; G03 full lifecycle/engine limits carry forward

limits: No HTTP/Workerd or anonymous RPC exercise of all 94 declarations.
No browser, real R2, remote D1, actual credit debit, provider call or durable Cloudflare replay.
The inherited draft-vision guard path remains open; no acceptance of all G09 guards is claimed.
Location direct-DB/Unicode diagnostic: four passes and five failures. The unchanged diagnostic source is archived as text and explicitly run by run-location-diagnostic.mjs.
